2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the btrfs_write_check function to honor the FMODE_NOCMTIME flag, which prevents updating the inode's c/mtime when writing files over NFSv4.2. This is necessary because nfsd sets this flag on files with delegated timestamps, and skipping the update ensures that the server's c/mtime does not become newer than the time reported by the delegation holder. The patch fixes a stat-dirty file issue found in git test t1092.
